observations.name: Indicator Removal on Host
observations.justification: The malware string 'CreateFile' was found in the binary. This string is characteristic of Indicator Removal on Host behavior. The presence of this specific string alone (no other Indicator Removal on Host-related string corroborates it) indicates the malware has capabilities associated with this technique, but with less certainty than a corroborated combination would.

observations.name: Indicator Removal on Host
observations.justification: The API functions CreateFileW, CreateFileA are all imported by the binary. This combination is characteristic of Indicator Removal on Host — multiple corroborating APIs together, not one import in isolation, is what makes this a strong signal.
